newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 ends higher, off day's best on weak Dow.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 ends higher, off day's best on weak Dow.

text.p: The UK's leading blue chip index ended a holiday-shortened week on a firmer note, bolstered by tax-year-end trading and end-of-quarter window dressing, dealers and strategists said.
The benchmark FTSE 100 share index closed 11.4 points higher at 4,312.9, but well off the day's best level at 4,331.4. Advancers outpaced decliners 56 to 38.
The index slipped toward the day's lows, just above support at 4,300, as Wall Street, which opened higher, gave up ground. The Dow was down about 48 points when London markets closed.
